title: iOS CI runner is pinned by the SDK the apps need
why: Skill ios-apps pins CI to the macos-26 image, but Home says that image has Xcode 26.6 and no iOS 27.1 SDK, and Degen runs xcode-27 with no exemption record. Either the pin is stale or each app needs an exemption form.
